title: Windbreak Canyon
wikitext:
[[File:Windbreak Canyon.jpg|thumb|Windbreak Canyon]]

'''Windbreak Canyon''' was a canyon filled with [[wind serpent]]s and their nests. This place covered most of the area between [[Freewind Post]] and the [[Shimmering Flats]] on the north side of the road in [[Thousand Needles]]. The path to the [[Weathered Nook]] can be found here.
